commands.text:
node bin/shipcheck.mjs init 2>&1 | tee /tmp/init.log
if [ -f "SHIP_GATE.md" ]; then
  echo "status=pass" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "status=fail" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

# audit may exit 3 (partial) which is valid
set +e
node bin/shipcheck.mjs audit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/audit.log
EXIT_CODE=$?
set -e
if [ "$EXIT_CODE" -eq 0 ] || [ "$EXIT_CODE" -eq 3 ]; then
  echo "status=pass" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "status=fail" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi
echo "exit_code=$EXIT_CODE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

# Check audit log contains gate results (shipcheck outputs summary lines)
if grep -q -E "(Checked:|Unchecked:|Skipped:|Pass rate:)" /tmp/audit.log; then
  echo "status=pass" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "status=fail" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

HELP="${{ steps.help.outputs.status }}"
INIT="${{ steps.init.outputs.status }}"
AUDIT="${{ steps.audit.outputs.status }}"
VERIFY="${{ steps.verify_output.outputs.status }}"
if [ "$HELP" = "pass" ] && [ "$INIT" = "pass" ] && [ "$AUDIT" = "pass" ] && [ "$VERIFY" = "pass" ]; then
  echo "verdict=pass" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "verdict=fail" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

FINISHED_AT=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
cat > /tmp/submission.json << 'INNER_EOF'
{
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "run_id": "shipcheck-RUN_ID-ATTEMPT",
  "repo": "REPO_SLUG",
  "ref": {
    "branch": "REF_NAME",
    "commit_sha": "COMMIT_SHA"
  },
  "source": {
    "provider": "github",
    "workflow": "ci.yml",
    "provider_run_id": "PROVIDER_RUN_ID",
    "attempt": ATTEMPT_NUM,
    "run_url": "RUN_URL_PLACEHOLDER",
    "actor": "ACTOR_NAME"
  },
  "timing": {
    "started_at": "STARTED_PLACEHOLDER",
    "finished_at": "FINISHED_PLACEHOLDER",
    "duration_ms": 0
  },
  "ci_checks": [
    { "id": "unit-tests", "kind": "test", "status": "pass", "value": 24 }
  ],
  "scenario_results": [
    {
      "scenario_id": "self-gate-real-repo",
      "scenario_name": "Self-gate against real repo",
      "scenario_version": "1.0.0",
      "product_surface": "cli",
      "execution_mode": "bot",
      "verdict": "VERDICT_PLACEHOLDER",
      "step_results": [
        { "step_id": "run-help", "status": "HELP_STATUS" },
        { "step_id": "run-init", "status": "INIT_STATUS" },
        { "step_id": "run-audit", "status": "AUDIT_STATUS" },
        { "step_id": "verify-output", "status": "VERIFY_STATUS" }
      ],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "kind": "log",
          "url": "RUN_URL_PLACEHOLDER",
          "description": "CI run log with audit output"
        },
        {
          "kind": "artifact",
          "url": "RUN_URL_PLACEHOLDER/artifacts",
          "description": "Audit log artifact (dogfood-audit-log)"
        }
      ],
      "notes": "Self-gate audit exit code: EXIT_CODE_PLACEHOLDER"
    }
  ],
  "overall_verdict": "VERDICT_PLACEHOLDER",
  "notes": "Pilot 1: shipcheck self-dogfood."
}
INNER_EOF

# Replace placeholders with actual values
sed -i "s|REPO_SLUG|${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|REF_NAME|${GITHUB_REF_NAME}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|COMMIT_SHA|${GITHUB_SHA}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|PROVIDER_RUN_ID|${GITHUB_RUN_ID}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|ATTEMPT_NUM|${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|RUN_URL_PLACEHOLDER|https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|ACTOR_NAME|${GITHUB_ACTOR}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|STARTED_PLACEHOLDER|${{ github.event.head_commit.timestamp }}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|FINISHED_PLACEHOLDER|${FINISHED_AT}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|shipcheck-RUN_ID-ATTEMPT|shipcheck-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|VERDICT_PLACEHOLDER|${{ steps.verdict.outputs.verdict }}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|HELP_STATUS|${{ steps.help.outputs.status }}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|INIT_STATUS|${{ steps.init.outputs.status }}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|AUDIT_STATUS|${{ steps.audit.outputs.status }}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|VERIFY_STATUS|${{ steps.verify_output.outputs.status }}|g" /tmp/submission.json
sed -i "s|EXIT_CODE_PLACEHOLDER|${{ steps.audit.outputs.exit_code }}|g" /tmp/submission.json

# Validate JSON
jq empty /tmp/submission.json
echo "Submission built:"
jq '.run_id, .overall_verdict' /tmp/submission.json

SUBMISSION=$(cat /tmp/submission.json)
RUN_ID=$(echo "$SUBMISSION" | jq -r '.run_id')

if [ -z "$GH_TOKEN" ]; then
  echo "::warning::DOGFOOD_TOKEN not set — skipping dispatch"
  exit 0
fi

# Build payload with submission as a proper JSON object (not string).
# Best-effort: the payload is already validated by the blocking `jq empty`
# in "Build submission" above, so only the outbound call is tolerant here.
# An expired or unscoped DOGFOOD_TOKEN must not redden a mainline whose
# product gates all passed -- it surfaces as a run-summary warning instead.
if jq -n --argjson sub "$SUBMISSION" \
  '{"event_type":"dogfood_submission","client_payload":{"submission":$sub}}' \
  | gh api repos/dogfood-lab/testing-os/dispatches \
    --input - --silent
then
  echo "Dispatched $RUN_ID to testing-os"
else
  echo "::warning::Dispatch of $RUN_ID to dogfood-lab/testing-os failed (check DOGFOOD_TOKEN validity and scope) -- not failing the build"
fi

commands.step: Verify release tag matches package.json version
commands.text:
PKG_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
echo "Tag: ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} -> ${TAG_VERSION} | Package: ${PKG_VERSION}"
if [ "${PKG_VERSION}" != "${TAG_VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "::error::Release tag ${TAG_VERSION} does not match package.json version ${PKG_VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi

commands.step: Install npm >= 11.5 in sandbox for OIDC trusted-publishing auth
commands.text:
# Node 22 bundles npm 10.x (no OIDC); an in-place `npm i -g npm@latest`
# races its own arborist rebuild. Install into an isolated sandbox.
SANDBOX="$HOME/.npm-cli-sandbox"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"
pushd "$SANDBOX" >/dev/null
echo '{"name":"npm-cli-sandbox","version":"0.0.0","private":true}' > package.json
npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --silent npm@latest
popd >/dev/null
echo "$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
"$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin/npm" --version

commands.step: Publish to npm with provenance (OIDC trusted publisher)

commands.text:
mkdir -p /tmp/repomesh
if compgen -G "dist/*.tgz" > /dev/null; then
  sha256sum dist/*.tgz > /tmp/repomesh/artifact-hashes.txt
elif compgen -G "bin/*.mjs" > /dev/null; then
  sha256sum bin/*.mjs > /tmp/repomesh/artifact-hashes.txt
else
  sha256sum package.json > /tmp/repomesh/artifact-hashes.txt
fi
cat /tmp/repomesh/artifact-hashes.txt

npm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx > /tmp/repomesh/sbom.json 2>/dev/null || echo '{"bomFormat":"CycloneDX","specVersion":"1.4","components":[]}' > /tmp/repomesh/sbom.json
sha256sum /tmp/repomesh/sbom.json | awk '{print $1}' > /tmp/repomesh/sbom-hash.txt
echo "SBOM generated ($(wc -c < /tmp/repomesh/sbom.json) bytes)"

VERSION="${{ github.ref_name }}"
gh release upload "$VERSION" /tmp/repomesh/sbom.json --clobber 2>/dev/null || echo "SBOM upload skipped"
gh release upload "$VERSION" /tmp/repomesh/provenance.json --clobber 2>/dev/null || echo "Provenance upload skipped"

REPO_SLUG="${{ github.event.repository.name }}"
VERSION="${{ github.ref_name }}"
BRANCH="event/${REPO_SLUG}/${VERSION}"

gh repo clone "${{ env.REPOMESH_LEDGER_REPO }}" /tmp/repomesh-ledger -- --depth 1
cd /tmp/repomesh-ledger

git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${{ env.REPOMESH_LEDGER_REPO }}.git"
git config user.name "repomesh-bot"
git config user.email "repomesh-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
git checkout -b "$BRANCH"

cat /tmp/repomesh/event.json >> ledger/events/events.jsonl
printf '\n' >> ledger/events/events.jsonl

git add ledger/events/events.jsonl
git commit -m "event: ${{ github.repository }}@${VERSION}"
git push origin "$BRANCH"

gh pr create \
  --repo "${{ env.REPOMESH_LEDGER_REPO }}" \
  --head "$BRANCH" \
  --title "event: ${{ github.repository }}@${VERSION}" \
  --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## RepoMesh Broadcast

**Repo:** ${{ github.repository }}
**Version:** ${{ github.ref_name }}
**Commit:** ${{ github.sha }}
**Type:** ReleasePublished

Automated event from release workflow. Ledger CI will verify schema, signature, and append-only rules.
EOF
)"
